caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic teapot or coffee pot placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The vessel has a cylindrical body that tapers slightly towards the top, with a wider base and a rounded lid. The lid is topped with a decorative knob that has a spherical tip and several distinct horizontal layers beneath it. The teapot features a tall, curved spout on the left side and a large, arching handle on the right, both of which have rounded, ball-shaped ends. The body and lid of the pot are rendered in a bluish-gray color, with subtle shading to indicate metallic texture and form. The handle, spout, and lid, as well as the decorative band near the top, are all consistent in color with the rest of the vessel. The background shows slight discoloration and faint marks, but it remains uniform and does not distract from the central object.
title: Pewter Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
